name: Whiplash

specialAbility.name: Lasso Grab
specialAbility.description: Whiplash swings a giant lasso to catch the enemy, yanking them off balance and boosting its own speed to zoom past!

lore: Yeehaw! Whiplash is the rootin'-tootinest cowboy truck in the whole arena! With golden paint that shines like a sheriff's badge and big ol' longhorns on the hood, Whiplash rounds up the competition like cattle. Its famous Lasso Grab can yank a truck clean off its wheels. Ride 'em, cowboy!
